headline: Watch Out for Fake E-Challan Links
summary: The Directorate of Transport has advised citizens to avoid fraudulent payment links and use only authorized portals to pay traffic challans due to a rise in cyber frauds.

headline: Goa Notifies Veterinary Upgrade Plan
summary: The Goa government has introduced a 24-month infrastructure upgrade plan for veterinary institutions, naming the Tonca Veterinary Hospital as the state's apex super-speciality facility.

headline: How Goa Became the Soul of IFFI
summary: After moving across multiple Indian cities for decades, the International Film Festival of India finally found a permanent and defining home in Goa starting November 2004.

headline: Registration Open for 57th IFFI
summary: Delegate registrations are currently underway for the 57th International Film Festival of India, scheduled to take place in Goa from November 20 to 28, 2026.

headline: Questions Raised Over Panaji Smart City Scam
summary: Public and opposition outcry over the alleged Panaji Smart City scam faded away after roadworks were completed, leaving lingering questions about accountability.

headline: Portal Switch Disrupts Vital Certificates
summary: The transition to a new government portal has temporarily taken essential services like birth and death certificate access offline without a clear restoration timeline.

headline: High Court Stays Census ST Notification
summary: The High Court has granted an interim stay on the Census Commissioner's notification regarding Goa's estimated Scheduled Tribe population following a constitutional challenge.

headline: Mandatory Certification for Poultry
summary: The Goa government has issued an immediate notification requiring all live poultry entering the state to carry official health and source certificates.

headline: New Type 1 Diabetes Programme Launched
summary: Goa's new comprehensive care programme will offer free insulin, monitoring supplies, and weekly clinics at select district and sub-district hospitals for Type 1 diabetes patients.

headline: Machinery Seized in Illegal Quarry Raid
summary: The Mines and Geology Department raided an alleged illegal laterite stone quarry at Naquerim, Quepem, seizing machinery and illegally extracted stones belonging to the Comunidade.
